content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 15.3(b) (p0274) is a mutual cap, but its basis — 3% of the bill-of-materials value of Products delivered — is far below the fallback floor of 12 months' fees, and Section 15 contains no carve-outs at all, leaving MSL's indemnity (15.1), confidentiality (13.2), gross negligence and willful misconduct inside the cap with no super-cap (walk-away territory).

**Redline (fallback level, validated ok:true):**
1. Re-based the existing mutual cap on "the fees paid or payable by IBM under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim," leaving the mutual "either Party" operator and the tort/contract language untouched.
2. Added a short new 15.3(c) carving indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct out of the cap.

The mutual consequential/lost-profits waiver in 15.3(a) was left alone, and the $25,000 limit in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement caps IBM's own exposure, so it was not flagged.
